evaluation_name: Phase 36 Ball Tracking and Possession Evaluation
hardware: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 (4 GB VRAM) + TrackNetV2-Lite ONNX

limitations.dense_scrimmage_occlusion: When ball is enclosed in a 3-player tackle contest, detection confidence drops below 0.40; system marks possession as UNCERTAIN.
limitations.fast_cross_motion_blur: High velocity driven crosses (>30 m/s) produce slight trajectory lag (1.5 frames) smoothed via Kalman post-filtering.
limitations.human_review_policy: All automated candidate turnovers require human reviewer confirmation prior to entering Tier A / B datasets.
